How much does it cost to charge a cordless vacuum?

Charging a cordless vacuum typically draws about 50 watts (25–120W depending on the model). Used for 4 hours per charge, 3 charges a week, it costs about 5.3p per charge and £8.21 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per charge
5.3p
About £8.21 a year at 4 hours per charge, 3 charges a week.

Standing charge not included.

Adjust for yours
Ofgem price cap average for 1 Oct – 31 Dec 2026 (standard variable tariff, Direct Debit, England, Scotland & Wales).

About these figures

Worth knowing: Charging, not run time.

Source for the typical figure: Typical range (estimate). See how we calculate.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Corded tools only draw power while running, so costs are small; it's runtime that adds up.
  • Charge cordless tools when needed, not continuously.
  • Keep filters and blades clean so motors work less hard.

Questions

How much does it cost to charge a cordless vacuum per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 50W model costs about 1.3p an hour while it's running.

How much does it cost to charge a cordless vacuum per year?

About £8.21 a year, based on 4 hours per charge, 3 charges a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my cordless vacuum's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
